subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require a live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection smoke before merging this narrow probe-header fix, or accept the disclosed credential gap?
rationale: The code and regression test prove the header is sent, but the PR lacks after-fix real service proof because the contributor does not have a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key.

options.title: Run the credentialed smoke
options.body: A maintainer with a redacted Coding Plan key posts live endpoint-detection output before selecting a canonical PR.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Maintainers explicitly waive the live credential gap because the branch is narrow and the linked issue already has live before-fix proof.

options.title: Use another sibling PR
options.body: Choose another open same-root-cause PR as the canonical landing path and close this one only after that path lands.

recommendation.title: Run the credentialed smoke
recommendation.body: A maintainer with a redacted Coding Plan key posts live endpoint-detection output before selecting a canonical PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for the Z.AI Coding Plan detection and onboarding behavior touched here.
